svg.title: Kunság study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Kunság; 2: Kiskőrös; 3: Kecskemét; 4: Izsák; 5: Soltvadkert; 6: Kiskunhalas; 7: Cegléd; 8: Monor; 9: Huszthymajor; 10: Talfája; 11: Szeged; 12: Szolnok

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
